items.source: AspectInstanceFactory implementation backed by a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 由 Spring BeanFactory 支持的AspectInstanceFactory实现。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现 MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory，为每次SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 调用创建指定 aspect 类的新实例。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: Decorator to cause a MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory to instantiate only once.
items.translation: 装饰器，用于使MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory仅实例化一次。
`MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory` 接口在 `org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation` 包中的用法

items.source: AspectInstanceFactory backed by a BeanFactory-provided prototype, enforcing prototype semantics.
items.translation: 由 `AspectInstanceFactory` 支持的、由 `BeanFactory` 提供的原型，强制执行原型语义。

items.source: Classes enabling AspectJ 5 @Annotated classes to be used in Spring AOP.
items.translation: 使 AspectJ 5 @Annotated 类能够在 Spring AOP 中使用的类。

items.source: Build a Spring AOP Advice for the given AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 为给定的 AspectJ 建议方法构建一个 Spring AOP 建议。

items.source: Build a Spring AOP Advisor for the given AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 为给定的 AspectJ 建议方法构建一个 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source:
Build Spring AOP Advisors for all annotated At-AspectJ methods
on the specified aspect instance.
items.translation: 为指定的切面实例上所有带注解的 AspectJ 方法构建 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source: Create a new lazily initializing decorator for the given AspectInstanceFactory.
items.translation: 为给定的 AspectInstanceFactory 创建一个懒加载装饰器。
